title: Claude Fable 5
content:
## Overview

Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable publicly available model, released on **June 9, 2026**. It is the first model from the "Mythos-class" tier — the capability level above Opus — that Anthropic has cleared for general availability. Fable 5 is state of the art on nearly every benchmark Anthropic tested at launch, with particular strength in software engineering, long-horizon autonomous tasks, and analytical reasoning.

---

## Benchmarks

| Benchmark | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | Next-best model 11 points behind |
| FrontierBench (Cognition) | **#1** | Highest-scoring model at launch |
| Core analytics benchmark | **>90%** | First model to break 90%; 10-point jump over Opus 4.8 |
| Frontier physics research | **#1** | Reached near-GPT-5.5 levels in 36 hours vs. four days |

In long-horizon autonomy evaluations, Anthropic tested Fable 5 playing the deck-builder *Slay the Spire* with persistent file-based memory. Fable 5 improved **3× more** than Opus 4.8 under the same conditions and reached the final act three times as often.

---

## Key Capabilities

### Always-On Adaptive Thinking
Fable 5 runs with adaptive thinking enabled by default. Unlike earlier models where extended thinking was an opt-in API parameter, Fable 5 reasons automatically on complex tasks and scales its thinking depth to match the problem.

### 1 Million Token Context Window
Fable 5 supports a **1M+ token context window** with 128K output tokens. This enables ingesting entire large codebases, lengthy research corpora, or multi-document legal filings in a single prompt.

### Long-Horizon Memory
Fable 5 is designed to hold focus across multi-session tasks by keeping notes it consults and updates during a run. This is the same mechanism that powers the Dreaming feature in Claude Managed Agents.

---

## Safety Architecture: Fallback to Opus 4.8

The broad release of Fable 5 is enabled by a built-in safety classifier. For requests touching flagged domains (primarily cybersecurity and biology), Fable 5 automatically falls back to **Claude Opus 4.8** rather than responding directly. Anthropic reports that the fallback triggers in fewer than 5% of sessions — more than 95% of sessions see Fable 5 respond without any fallback.

This classifier-plus-fallback architecture is what distinguishes Fable 5 from its restricted sibling, Claude Mythos 5.

---

## Claude Mythos 5 (Limited Availability)

Claude Mythos 5 shares the same underlying model weights as Fable 5 but ships **without the safety classifiers**. It is available only through **Project Glasswing**, Anthropic's limited-access program for vetted research and government partners. It is not available via the standard API or claude.ai.

---

## Export Control Suspension (June 12, 2026)

Three days after launch, on June 12, 2026, Anthropic received a US government export-control directive requiring it to **suspend access to both Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5**. As of the directive, access was paused for users outside jurisdictions approved under the directive. Anthropic has not publicly specified a timeline for restoration.

---

## Pricing (API)

| Token type | Price |
|---|---|
| Input | $10.00 / 1M tokens |
| Output | $50.00 / 1M tokens |

Fable 5 is priced above Opus 4.8 ($15/$75 per 1M in/out at the time of Opus 4.7 launch), reflecting its position as the new ceiling model.

---

## Model ID

The API model ID is `claude-fable-5`. Adaptive thinking is on by default; no additional parameter is required.

---

## Relationship to the Claude 4 Family

Fable 5 represents a new tier above the Claude 4.x Opus/Sonnet/Haiku family. The current lineup as of June 2026:

| Tier | Model | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fable | Fable 5 | New top tier; Mythos-class with safety classifiers |
| Opus | Opus 4.8 | Updated May 28, 2026; workhorse for complex tasks |
| Sonnet | Sonnet 4.6 | Default balanced model |
| Haiku | Haiku 4.5 | Fastest/cheapest |
